title: 照明控制与开路短路
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/187_照明控制与开路短路.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/187_照明控制与开路短路/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在楼梯口，手边一个开关，楼上一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the bottom of a staircase beside a wall switch, one lamp hanging above the stairs, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第二十五课：照明控制与开路短路。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一根导线，想把电源两端碰一下看看短路
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a loose wire near two supply terminals on a bench with the indicator lamp lit, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰：短路什么样？碰一下看看？

shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator switches the bench off and shakes his head, a crossed out wire across supply terminals icon.
shots.narration: 王老师：电源绝不能直接短接！

shots.scene: 小研拿着电路图：实验短接的只是一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shows a blank circuit diagram with two lamps in series and a switch across one lamp.
shots.narration: 小研：实验短接的只是一盏灯。

shots.scene: 两地、多地控灯，列真值表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a staircase and a long corridor with several switches controlling one lamp, a blank truth table grid. No text.
shots.narration: 实验一：两地、三地控灯，列出真值表。

shots.scene: 开路与短路时电压电流的变化
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a circuit with an open switch and a closed switch side by side, a voltmeter and an ammeter. No text.
shots.narration: 实验二：观察开路、短路时电压电流。

shots.scene: 接地电阻由老师用专用仪表测
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an earthing rod and an earth resistance tester operated by a teacher icon, students watching. No text.
shots.narration: 接地电阻，由老师用专用仪表演示。

shots.scene: 楼梯上下都能开关同一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a staircase with a switch at the bottom and a switch at the top, both controlling the same lamp. No text.
shots.narration: 两地控制：楼梯上下都能开关一盏灯。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bedroom with one switch by the door and one by the bed, controlling the ceiling lamp. No text.
shots.narration: 卧室门口和床头，也常这样装。

shots.scene: 电源、一盏灯、两只双控开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single phase supply, one lamp and two single pole double throw switches. No text.
shots.narration: 单相电源、一盏灯、两只双控开关。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two traveler wires running between the two contacts of switch one and switch two. No text.
shots.narration: 两只开关之间，用两根联络线相连。

shots.scene: 【实拍】双控开关的公共端和两个触点
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a finger pointing at the common terminal and the two contact terminals of a two way switch on a powered off wiring board.
shots.narration: 双控开关是单极双掷，公共端加两触点。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lamp, switches and wires with matching rating icons, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 灯、开关、导线的额定值要相配。

shots.scene: 相线经熔断器到开关一公共端
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the line conductor passing through a fuse into the common terminal of switch one. No text.
shots.narration: 相线先经熔断器，接开关一公共端。

shots.scene: 开关二公共端接灯，灯接中性线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the common terminal of switch two wired to the lamp, the lamp wired to the neutral conductor. No text.
shots.narration: 开关二公共端接灯，灯再接中性线。

shots.scene: 开关接零线，关了灯也带电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a switch placed on the neutral, the lamp holder still glowing as live when off, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 开关接零线，关了灯，灯座照样带电。

shots.scene: 【实拍】螺口灯座的中心触点和螺纹
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a finger pointing at the center contact and then the screw thread of an empty screw lamp holder on a powered off board.
shots.narration: 螺口灯座：相线经开关接中心触点。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the screw thread wired to the neutral conductor, a hand touching the thread while changing a bulb with no shock. No text.
shots.narration: 螺纹接零线，换灯碰到螺纹也不带电。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the line conductor on the thread with an electric shock warning sign, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 接反了，螺纹带电，很危险。

shots.scene: 【实拍】断电时用带插头导线按图接线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands plugging insulated banana plug leads into a powered off wiring board following a blank circuit diagram.
shots.narration: 断电后备齐器材，按图一根根接。

shots.scene: 先连两开关之间，再接灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: numbered steps, first the traveler wires between the switches, then the lamp and the neutral. No text.
shots.narration: 先连两开关之间，再接灯和中性线。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student handing a blank truth table sheet to a teacher icon before the bench. No text.
shots.narration: 做实验前，先画好真值表交老师。

shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the wiring board and the truth table, then nods to allow power on.
shots.narration: 老师查过接线、同意了，才开始做。

shots.scene: 扳开关一灯亮，扳开关二灯灭
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: switch one flipped and the lamp lights, then switch two flipped and the lamp goes dark. No text.
shots.narration: 扳开关一，灯亮；再扳开关二，灯灭。

shots.scene: 位置对应灯亮，错开灯灭
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a four row truth table drawn with switch position icons and lamp on or off icons. No text.
shots.narration: 两开关位置对应灯亮，错开灯灭。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: either switch toggled and the lamp state flips each time, a circular arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 规律：拨动任何一个，灯就翻转。

shots.scene: 长走廊、大库房多处控灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long corridor and a large storeroom with three switches along the wall controlling one lamp. No text.
shots.narration: 长走廊、大库房，多处都要能开关灯。

shots.scene: 两端双控，中间加中间开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two way switches at both ends and an intermediate switch in the middle. No text.
shots.narration: 两端还是双控开关，中间加中间开关。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an intermediate switch with its two inputs connected straight across to its two outputs. No text.
shots.narration: 中间开关第一种状态：直通。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the intermediate switch with its two inputs connected crosswise to its two outputs. No text.
shots.narration: 第二种状态：交叉，一按就切换。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a straight icon and a cross icon with an either or arrow between them. No text.
shots.narration: 同一时刻，只能是其中一种。

shots.scene: 开关一两根线接中间开关一侧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two traveler wires from switch one to one side of the intermediate switch, the other side to switch two. No text.
shots.narration: 开关一的两根线，接到中间开关一侧。

shots.scene: 另一侧接开关二，再接灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the other side of the intermediate switch to switch two, then the lamp and the neutral. No text.
shots.narration: 另一侧接开关二，再接灯和中性线。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the intermediate switch set straight while the two end switches are toggled, then set crossed and repeated. No text.
shots.narration: 先直通扳两开关，再换交叉重复。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eight row truth table with icons for three switches and a lamp. No text.
shots.narration: 三地控制，一共八种状态。

shots.scene: 直通同双控，交叉正相反
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the top four rows on off off on and the bottom four rows off on on off with lamp icons. No text.
shots.narration: 直通亮灭灭亮，交叉灭亮亮灭。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: any of three switches toggled flips the lamp, a circular arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 拨动任何一个开关，灯就翻转。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finger pressing only the plastic switch lever on a live wiring board, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 通电后，只碰开关手柄。

shots.scene: 插孔、插头金属、灯座不碰
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: open sockets, metal plug pins and a lamp holder with an electric shock warning sign, a hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 插孔、插头金属、灯座，一概不碰。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a metal watch and a ring removed and placed in a tray before the experiment. No text.
shots.narration: 摘下手表、戒指等金属饰品。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glowing incandescent bulb with heat waves and a hot surface warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 白炽灯亮一会儿，就很烫。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand unscrewing a cool bulb from a lamp holder on a wiring board whose main switch is off.
shots.narration: 换灯泡：先断电，等凉了再拧。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: paper sheets near a hot bulb crossed out, a clear area around the lamp checked. No text.
shots.narration: 灯泡旁边不放纸张杂物。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: household appliances connected in parallel across the supply, each with the same voltage. No text.
shots.narration: 家里的电器都是并联，电压一样。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one appliance switched off while the others keep working. No text.
shots.narration: 关掉一个电器，别的照常用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: appliances in series sharing the voltage, one off making all off, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 要是串联，电压被分掉，一断全断。

shots.scene: 开路：电路断开，电流为零
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a circuit with a gap in one wire, no current arrow flowing. No text.
shots.narration: 开路：电路某处断开，电流为零。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two conductors touching directly with a bypass path around the load, a large current arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 短路：两线直接相碰，电流非常大。

shots.scene: 风雨天电线相碰会短路
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: overhead wires swinging in a storm and touching with a spark, a person keeping far away. No text.
shots.narration: 风雨天电线相碰会短路，远离断线。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an open circuit icon and a short circuit icon with opposite arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 开路和短路，特点正好相反。

shots.scene: 交流电流表、电压表、两盏灯、一个开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alternating current ammeter, a voltmeter, two lamps and a switch laid out on a bench. No text.
shots.narration: 器材：交流电流表、电压表、两灯一开关。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a multimeter on the alternating voltage range standing in for a voltmeter. No text.
shots.narration: 没有电压表，可用万用表交流电压挡。

shots.scene: 电源经双极开关和熔断器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single phase supply passing through a double pole switch and a fuse to the experiment board. No text.
shots.narration: 单相电源经双极开关和熔断器引出。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: insulated plug leads checked, bare twisted wire ends crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 导线带合适插头，不用裸线头。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the line conductor to lamp one, lamp one to lamp two, lamp two to the neutral, all in series. No text.
shots.narration: 相线、灯一、灯二、零线，串成主回路。

shots.scene: 电流表和开关跨接灯一
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ammeter in series with switch one connected across lamp one with a thicker wire. No text.
shots.narration: 电流表和开关串联，跨接在灯一两端。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltmeter connected across lamp one with thin leads, both meters on suitable ranges. No text.
shots.narration: 电压表并在灯一两端，量程选合适。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: numbered steps, the series main loop wired first, then the parallel branches. No text.
shots.narration: 接线顺序：先接串联，后接并联。

shots.scene: 【实拍】通电前开关S1处于断开位置
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a small switch on a powered off experiment board set clearly to the off position.
shots.narration: 通电时，开关S1必须先断开。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a meter terminal range checked, then divisions counted on the matching scale. No text.
shots.narration: 先看接哪个量程，再数小格算读数。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: switch one open, the voltmeter needle deflected, the ammeter needle at zero, two lamps dim. No text.
shots.narration: S1断开是开路：电压表有较大读数。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the ammeter at zero beside the open gap of switch one. No text.
shots.narration: 断开处有电压，支路电流为零。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: switch one closed, lamp one dark, lamp two brighter, the ammeter now deflected. No text.
shots.narration: 闭合S1，灯一被短接，熄灭了。

shots.scene: 电流表有读数，电压为零
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the ammeter needle up and the voltmeter needle at zero across lamp one. No text.
shots.narration: 电流表有读数，灯一两端电压为零。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a results table with switch state, voltage, current and lamp state columns filled with icons. No text.
shots.narration: 开关状态、电压、电流、灯，填进表。

shots.scene: 开路电压大电流零，短路电流大电压零
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two summary icons, open with a voltage arrow and zero current, short with a current arrow and zero voltage. No text.
shots.narration: 开路有压无流，短路有流无压。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: lamp two glowing in series and limiting the current while lamp one is bypassed, a small current arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 实验只短接灯一，灯二还在限流。

shots.scene: 电源直接短路电流惊人
shots.prompt_en: Animation: a protected supply with a fuse, a wire across the supply terminals shown only in a diagram, a huge current arrow and the fuse breaking. No text.
shots.narration: 电源直接短路，电流会大得惊人。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an overheated wire, an arc flash icon and a small fire icon, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 导线过热、电弧、起火，瞬间发生。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wire bridging supply terminals with a big red cross, a protective fuse and breaker beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 严禁拿导线直接短接电源。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a screwdriver, keys and wire offcuts falling toward live terminals crossed out, a clear bench checked. No text.
shots.narration: 工具、钥匙、线头，别掉到端子上。

shots.scene: 熔断跳闸，先断电查原因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blown fuse and a tripped breaker, a hand switching off and a teacher icon checking. No text.
shots.narration: 熔断、跳闸，先断电，请老师查原因。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand forcing a breaker back on crossed out and a larger fuse swapped in crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不强行合闸，不换大熔丝。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two lamps in series sharing the voltage, both glowing dimly. No text.
shots.narration: 答辩：开路时两灯串联分压，都较暗。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: lamp one dark and lamp two glowing at full brightness. No text.
shots.narration: 短路时灯一熄灭，灯二得全压变亮。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a moving iron meter and a moving coil meter side by side with wave and battery icons. No text.
shots.narration: 还要会比较动铁式和磁电式仪表。

shots.scene: 双控单极双掷，三地加中间开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two two way switches and an intermediate switch controlling one lamp, a truth table icon. No text.
shots.narration: 双控用单极双掷，三地加中间开关。

shots.scene: 开关熔断器接相线，螺口中心接相线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a switch and a fuse on the line conductor and the center contact of a screw holder highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 开关熔断器接相线，灯座中心接相线。

shots.scene: 开路无流，短路大流，绝不短接电源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an open circuit icon, a short circuit icon and a crossed out wire across supply terminals. No text.
shots.narration: 开路无流短路大流，绝不短接电源。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着星形和三角形的三相接线图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a large diagram of a star connection and a delta connection, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：三相连接与三相电机。
